one_liner: Schedule-driven recurring payments: define recipient, amount, interval, and stop conditions — each tick pays the single due installment, exactly once.
what_it_does: This lamp sets up a payment schedule — who gets paid, how much, how often, and when to stop — then pays exactly one installment per tick. It can't double-pay a tick, and the schedule stops itself at the configured limits. Proven by 1 real live installment payment on the Atlantic testnet, linked below.
